mapper.select: SELECT c.relname AS TABLE_NAME, COALESCE(c.reltuples::BIGINT, -1) AS ROW_COUNT FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = CURRENT_SCHEMA() AND c.relkind = 'r' AND c.relname IN #{t}
SELECT table_name AS TABLE_NAME, NVL(num_rows, -1) AS ROW_COUNT FROM user_tables WHERE table_name IN #{t}
SELECT UPPER(table_name) AS TABLE_NAME, IFNULL(table_rows, -1) AS ROW_COUNT FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name IN #{t}
SELECT UPPER(table_name) AS TABLE_NAME, IFNULL(table_rows, -1) AS ROW_COUNT FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name IN #{t}

SELECT t.name AS TABLE_NAME, ISNULL(SUM(p.rows), -1) AS ROW_COUNT FROM sys.tables t INNER JOIN sys.partitions p ON t.object_id = p.object_id WHERE t.schema_id = SCHEMA_ID() AND p.index_id IN (0, 1) AND t.name IN #{t} GROUP BY t.object_id, t.name
